## When to Use

Use this template when timesheet tracking template aligns with your project needs and governance requirements. This template is designed to support your project by providing structure and ensuring key considerations are documented.

## When NOT to Use

Do not use this template if your organization has established alternative processes or standards for this function, or if the level of detail exceeds your project's needs or governance requirements.

## Instructions

### How to Complete This Timesheet

1. **Fill in header information** at the top of the timesheet
2. **Record daily activities** with start/end times for each project or task
3. **Use project codes** provided by your manager or PMO
4. **Calculate total hours** for each day and each project
5. **Complete weekly summary** section
6. **Submit by [day of week]** each week
7. **Keep copies** for your records

### Project Codes Guide

| Code | Project/Activity |
|---|---|
| [PROJ001] | [Project Name] |
| [PROJ002] | [Project Name] |
| [ADMIN] | Administrative Tasks |
| [MEET] | Meetings |
| [TRAIN] | Training |
| [PTO] | Paid Time Off |
| [SICK] | Sick Leave |

### Time Tracking Tips

- **Track time in real-time** when possible
- **Be specific** in your task descriptions
- **Round to nearest quarter hour** (0.25, 0.50, 0.75)
- **Include breaks** of 30 minutes or more
- **Submit on time** to avoid payroll delays

---

*This timesheet must be completed accurately and submitted by [deadline] each week.*
